honors.title: Macaulay Data Science Pipeline Fellowship
honors.description: The inaugural summer program ran in 2016. Responsibilities for the pipeline program included attending Spring bootcamps (or completing equivalent course preparation as outlined by the professor), enrolling and maintaining satisfactory progress in Macaulay’s big data course taking place at MHC from June 6-23, 2016, applying for a research assistant/internship opportunity, and working with a matched mentor throughout the 2016/17 school year.

projects.title: NowPosted
projects.description:
NowPosted is a text messaging service that sends out daily text messages of new job postings, via indeed, for a desired position. Requires a simple sign up form and then uses the Indeed API to search for new job postings each day. The number of registered users is ~20.

Powered by Python, Flask, Twilio, Indeed, and TinyURL!

projects.title: WantON
projects.description:
WantON is a Flask server that responds to image text-messages with three different addresses of restaurants nearby that likely have the food that is depicted in the image. 

Powered by Python, Flask, Twilio, Clarifai, and Yelp!
